scope: Fixed-Evidence replay pilot; real provider, production Python runtime and isolated PG. No ingestion, dense retrieval, Java auth or browser acceptance.
assessment: Source-based Codex AI review, not blind and not a human gold standard. Runtime model review is not used as semantic scoring.

independent_candidate_review.basis: Codex AI review, not human gold; reasons in case details.

limitations: Six development tasks on previously seen public passages, not held-out.
Fixed Evidence replay, not live dense retrieval or browser/Java acceptance.
Two failed review calls have no complete usage; known token totals are lower bounds.
Remote model aliases and hardware are not immutable verified identities.
Full provider responses on failed review calls were not retained; exact invalid field is unknown.
